common_scope.selection_candidate: equal mean of ICBHI and SPRSound validation native Scores; no sample-count pooling
common_scope.selection_status: recommended clean candidate only; joint-core and validation-only selection remain unapproved and must not replace historical test-selected rules without user decision

hf_current_primary.target_positive: Wheeze or Rhonchi or Stridor annotation
hf_current_primary.target_negative: D-only inside the annotation-eligible evaluation pool
hf_current_primary.score: maximum across three fixed 5-s windows of weak/clip-level p_W
hf_current_primary.boundary: Wheeze-head ranking proxy against the broad CAS union, not a semantically complete CAS detector

pcmcl_frozen_raw_concat.name: PC-MCL frozen-encoder respiratory adaptation
pcmcl_frozen_raw_concat.train_input: two dataset-homogeneous native units, each normalized to 5 s by the paper repeat-pad/center-crop policy, then concatenated in waveform space to 10 s
pcmcl_frozen_raw_concat.composite_label: positive if either constituent has an observed positive; negative only if both are observed negatives; otherwise unknown
pcmcl_frozen_raw_concat.patient_pairs: same-patient positives and different-patient hard negatives with matching supported pathology profiles, never across datasets
pcmcl_frozen_raw_concat.cache: new per-seed cache of pooled embeddings produced after the frozen encoder sees each deterministic 10-s raw concatenation
pcmcl_frozen_raw_concat.hf_primary_readout: current-table maximum-window p_W proxy; p_C is excluded
pcmcl_frozen_raw_concat.claim: historical candidate only; do not execute

dcase_respiratory.name: DCASE-style masked CRNN respiratory adaptation
trainable: frame classifier and class-masked attention readout
dcase_respiratory.loss: masked weak-label BCE over eligible sample/class entries
dcase_respiratory.mean_teacher: omitted because the recommended source protocol has no approved unlabeled respiratory pool
dcase_respiratory.mixup: omitted in the first matched baseline so augmentation is not an extra comparison axis
dcase_respiratory.cache: new shared frozen BEATs frame cache; existing pooled caches are incompatible
dcase_respiratory.hf_primary_readout: weak attention-pooled p_W for each fixed 5-s window, followed by maximum across the three windows
dcase_respiratory.hf_secondary_diagnostic: maximum-window max(p_W,p_Other) only if Other remains strictly Rhonchi/Stridor; report separately from the current p_W CAS column
dcase_respiratory.hf_inference_mask: all four output channels enabled for every HF recording; only padding frames are masked; target annotations never select output classes
dcase_respiratory.claim: DCASE-style respiratory adaptation; not a DCASE Task 4 reproduction
